import java.util.Scanner;

public class LuckyTickets {

    private static final int MOD = 998244353;

    private static long powMod(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt() / 2;
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int[] digits = new int[m];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            digits[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        // dp[i][sum] = number of ways to get sum using i digits
        int maxSum = n * 9;
        long[][] dp = new long[n + 1][maxSum + 1];
        dp[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxSum; s++) {
                if (dp[i][s] == 0) continue;
                for (int d : digits) {
                    if (s + d <= maxSum) {
                        dp[i + 1][s + d] = (dp[i + 1][s + d] + dp[i][s]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long result = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s <= maxSum; s++) {
            result = (result + dp[n][s] * dp[n][s]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
